newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down on bearish data and soyoil.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down on bearish data and soyoil.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed lower on weaker soyoil and a bearish report from crop forecaster Ivan Wong, traders said. The market consolidated as players awaited more fresh developments at the start of the week. June futures trading range remains at between 1,230 and 1,250 level.
PALM PHYSICAL -The market was also easier in line with futures, with interest seen among nearby CPOs.

Wong put palm oil stocks at end-March at 725,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 722,993 tonnes at end-February. Exports were estimated at 560,000 tonnes against February's 376,885 tonnes.
"The market is seen consolidating at between the 1,230 and 1,250 range (June futures) as there was no certain leads in the market," a trader said.

"If the contract breaks out of the (1,230-1,250) range, we may see some volatility either in the upper or lower trading range," a trader said. At the close the contract was six ringgit lower at 1,238 ringgit ($495.89) a tonne.
Traders expect the market to move in a boxed-range in the near-term unless some fresh leads appear. Uncertainty in the fundamental outlook also limited price movements, traders said.
Turnover on the futures market was 1,367 lots.
Physicals April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,292.50 ringgit vs bids of 1,287.50 after trading at 1,287.50 to 1,290. April (central) saw offers at 1,275 vs bids 1,270.
May (south) was offered at 1,280 and bids at 1,275 with earlier trades at 1,275. May (central) was offered at 1,275 against 1,270.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $545 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $540, June at $537.50.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $580, May at $577.50, Jun at $572.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $565.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $437.50 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
